pattern.description: After the agent reply has scrolled in, the frame holds while the reply text and time-slot list show only a very faint residual change (sub-pixel settle or re-render); no element visibly enters or moves.
pattern.why_premium: The demo holds on the finished answer long enough for the narration to land on it, rather than cutting away the moment the reply arrives.

build_hint.gsap: No authored tween needed; if reproducing the settle, end the previous reply tween with a long ease tail (e.g. ease: 'expo.out', duration 0.9) so the last 1-2 px resolve over ~0.5 s.
build_hint.remotion: Hold the frame; if reproducing, let the previous reply translateY spring settle with a slightly overdamped config (damping ~30, stiffness ~120) so the tail runs into this window.
